Name: Light Magic
Other names: Light, Valona’s Light
Summary
The magic of Valona, Lady of Light, and the power behind the Staff of Light. It’s gold and white.
Details
Colour: white and gold
Source: Valona, Lady of Light
Known users: Valona, Celos, Mah’los Sinclair Crystalline, Zah’mes, Cilla, Ciles, LaRoash, Ashe
How it works
Light Magic is similar in practice to Valisian magic, but it is less dangerous to the person using it.
It can take many forms.
Who can use it
Valona is its source.
History
After the War of Light and the sealing of the Demon King Zornov, Valona forged the Staff of Light.
Notes per book
Shards of Light (Book 1). Tom recovers the white crystal shard from Zah’mes.
The Reign of Zornov (Book 2). When Ralos is unmasked, readers see the full extent of the burn.
Relationships
Source: Valona
Opposed by: Demonic Magic
Related to: Valisian Magic
Powers: Staff of Light
Used by: Celos, Mah’los Sinclair Crystalline, Zah’mes
Spoilers
The cause of Ralos’s burn is revealed in Book 2.
